resources.string: When you start recording, this research collector captures full-screen pixels in memory to compute local embeddings and reads foreground package names, window class names, and window types. It pauses while locked and resumes after unlock until you stop recording. It never saves screenshots, reads accessibility text or view hierarchies, performs gestures, or interacts with other apps. Keyboards stay part of their host app screen. Notification panels are labeled as system screens. Explicitly excluded apps and protected or unidentified screens pause collection.
